scope: mandatory credential-free Linux arm64 platform conformance; not portable or simulated proof

cases.name: actual-cli-baseline
cases.workload: Run the immutable actual CLI through the existing neutral tool roundtrip with independent syscall observation.

cases.name: scratch-alias-to-protected
cases.workload: Attempt update and create through a private-scratch symlink into a read-only protected directory.

cases.name: cwd-dirfd-change
cases.workload: Use synchronized cwd changes and descriptor close/reuse before relative openat mutation into protected space.

cases.name: relative-traversal
cases.workload: Attempt protected create/update using relative parent traversal from scratch.

cases.name: missing-protected-parent
cases.workload: Attempt creation below a nonexistent child of a protected directory, receiving ENOENT.

cases.name: concurrent-path-replacement
cases.workload: Use deterministic barriers around a scratch mutation while a competing thread attempts to redirect its alias into protected space. After permitted serialization, attempt a second mutation through the now-protected alias. The protected attempt must be denied or unresolved; an earlier proven scratch operation may succeed.

cases.name: incomplete-observer-coverage
cases.workload: Deliberately omit a descendant or required syscall record while the workload exits zero.

cases.name: observer-interruption
cases.workload: Interrupt the observer while the workload and a descendant remain active and attempt later writes.
